Name: AT - More Children Variation
Author: Mmmminerals
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Visual Mod that changes Toddler visual with Winter outfit. Has color sets for bachelors and bachelorettes. For Alternative Textures.

I'm sorry I might ramble a bit, but I will bold the important ones;

I made this content pack since I couldn't find a children content pack that is not Content Patcher. Maybe it's out there but I just haven't found it yet.

[size=5][font=Arial Black]Disclaimer![/font][/size]
[list]
[*]I'm not exactly tech savvy and this is my first content pack. There [b][font=Arial Black]might be another update[/font] [/b]as I can only work on this every weekend. Any bugs you might find is due to my lack of knowledge as I just stared at the AT wiki and looking at other AT mods as reference.[/*]
[*]The [font=Arial Black][b]babies CAN be changed[/b],[/font] it's just that they're pretty much just a [b][font=Arial Black]recolor of the vanilla babies[/font][/b]. Currently, not all marriage candidates' children have a baby version.[/*]
[*]The girl will be wearing pants. Not much to it, I just can't figure out the skirt. I'm not exactly a pixel artist lol. Might add skirt if there is some demand for it.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]You can extract it and put it into your mod folder, just make sure you got [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. To change the visual, buy the scissors from Robin and click on the kids.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
This mod have a color set for each vanilla marriage candidate with some additional "base set" to maybe match your farmer more. Each set has a light skin version and a dark skin version.

[b]Base set colors:[/b]
[list]
[*]Light Brown: Light brown hair with brown eyes[/*]
[*]Black: Black hair with black eyes[/*]
[*]Blonde: Blonde hair with light blue eyes[/*]
[*]Silver: Silver hair with matching eyes[/*]
[/list]Spouse's children will have the same colors as your spouse (Sam's children will have blonde hair and green eyes, Leah's children will have ginger hair and bright purple eyes, etc.)

For the girls, they have 3 hairstyles:
[list]
[*]Short[/*]
[*]Long[/*]
[*]Pigtails[/*]
[/list][b]When winter comes[/b], the children will wear a [b]winter outfit[/b]. The color of this outfit is based on my favorite Sanrio characters Kiki and Lala!

There might be more variations in the future, especially since I can't figure out what other hairstyles to give the boys. So, for now they only have the short hair.

[b]Some sets look VERY alike. [/b]Some marriage candidates to have similar hair and eye colors, so the children doesn't look too different from each other for some spouses (ex: Maru and Harvey both have brown hair and brown eyes). I do try to make the brown hairs look different saturation-wise, but I can imagine it won't look that different in-game.

Also, they don't do the arm wiggle anymore, they raise their arms like they're asking for uppies.
